description: This file defines a PHP class for the AWS Redshift Data API Service client, providing method signatures for interactions like executing statements and listing schemas over the Redshift Data API.

classes.name: RedshiftDataAPIServiceClient
classes.description: PHP client class for interacting with the AWS Redshift Data API Service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatement
methods.description: Method to execute a batch of SQL statements on Redshift.

methods.name: cancelStatement
methods.description: Method to cancel an ongoing statement execution.

methods.name: describeStatement
methods.description: Method to describe a specific statement.

methods.name: describeTable
methods.description: Method to describe a table in Redshift.

methods.name: executeStatement
methods.description: Method to execute an SQL statement.

methods.name: getStatementResult
methods.description: Method to retrieve the result of a statement execution.

methods.name: getStatementResultV2
methods.description: Method to retrieve the result of a statement execution, version 2.
